title: Kiribati: A nation on the frontline of climate change

title: Kiribati Natural Disasters and Climate Change Survey Report 2023–2024
organization: Kiribati National Statistics Office and Pacific Community
temporal_coverage: Household impacts during 2023–2024; HIES survey period.
methodology: Natural-disaster module in the 2023–2024 Household Income and Expenditure Survey; 1,208 households interviewed, weighted for population estimates.
limitations: PDF is marked DRAFT. Results have sampling uncertainty, no cross-variable statistical correlations, and an internal 25%/26% affected-population discrepancy; affected-household results are used instead.
